prompt:
A desktop e-commerce homepage for First Nutrition, an official sports-supplement distributor in Jordan and Lebanon, rendered edge to edge as a finished website screen with crisp, readable text; no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor's job: pick a training goal and order the right supplements on WhatsApp, cash on delivery. What leads is one enormous red 25 kg competition bumper plate, seen straight on and filling the right half of the first screen. Its stencilled rim reads BUILD MUSCLE, and its steel hub shows the stack total '108 JOD'. The knurled bar's sleeve enters from the left edge and runs through the hub. Three smaller change plates hang on the sleeve to its left and are the other goals you can pull on: BULK, CUT, PERFORM. On the chalked platform beneath, the stack stands in a row, each tub with a small paper ticket: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey 5 lb 50 JOD, MuscleTech Platinum Creatine 28 JOD, Scivation Xtend 30 JOD, each ticket stamped 'Official stock'. A red button reads 'Order this stack on WhatsApp'. On the left, a huge stencil headline 'LOAD YOUR GOAL.' and a line: 'Official distributor · 21 brands · ISO 9001 / 22000 / 45001 · Cash on delivery across Jordan'.

Frame: the First Nutrition wordmark in red at top left, navigation Shop, Brands, Offers, Branches, About, a search field, a Jordan · JOD switch, an العربية language switch, and a cart.

Visual law: white and chalk-grey ground with competition red #ED312E as the only colour, used at plate scale. Every plate is either red or black rubber with white stencil lettering; no blue, yellow or green plates, and no manufacturer names on any plate. Condensed industrial stencil numerals and caps as printed on real competition plates, a sturdy grotesk for body text. Photographic knurled steel and rubber, bright, not dark, not cartoon.
